messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick sprint kickoff 1: we need a compact battlecard + webinar hook that contrasts 'serving-first' economics vs cloud AI and API shops. goal: rep-ready one-pagers + subject lines.
Ravi (Content): cool. let's avoid rehashing raw benchmark numbers in the opener; focus on customer outcomes (stable bills, predictable latency). short soundbites only.
Sam (Sales): reps want: 1) 1-line opener 2) 2-line discovery 3) two quick knockouts they can use mid-call. keep it <30s.
Noor (PMM): angle: "migration assurance" + "cost transparency". procurement cares about exit clauses & auditability; include that on the one-pager.
Priya (Research): I'll provide a one-paragraph methods blurb and a tiny p95/cost table. bench notes: continuous batching on, prefix caching for chat, quantization profiles tested.
Owen (Field): add an ops checklist: SLA minima, KMS/HSM, private VPC deploy, data egress patterns. I'll draft vendor-exit language.
Maya (Marketing): deliverables = 1) 1-liner + 2-line 2) 1-page PDF battlecard 3) procurement FAQ stub 4) webinar concept + landing copy 5) 3 subject lines. owners?
Sam (Sales): Ill own 1 + the two knockouts. will post drafts in ~3h.
Ravi (Content): I'll create the one-pager template and 6-slide TL;DR. want something drop-in for SDR decks.
Noor (PMM): I'll own webinar format and landing copy. propose short exec slot + deep tech breakout.
Priya (Research): posting methods blurb and a tiny table in-thread in 2h. will include exact knob settings so folks can reuse.
Maya (Marketing): sample soundbites I'm throwing in to seed: 
- 1-liner: "Redwood Inference: serving-first runtime that makes LLMs predictable and economical in production."
- 2-line: "Dont buy inference by brand. Buy the runtime that keeps latency steady, lowers unit cost, and makes rollouts safe. Reserved capacity, verified runtime, and observability built-in."
Sam (Sales): nice. small quality guard add: "prompt-linked evals + regression alerts" so buyers don't assume cost = quality tradeoff.
Priya (Research): added. say: "We tie quantization and batching changes to prompt-linked evals to catch regressions."
Sam (Sales): competitor knockouts (draft):
- vs cloud platforms: "They sell models and scale; we sell predictable SLAs and unit-economics controls for production traffic."
- vs API-first shops: "Same API ergonomics but with private deploys, version pinning, and rollback policies."
Maya (Marketing): perfect. Noor  for webinar hook, can we use an anonymized customer narrative? short headline: "How a customer cut inference spend ~30% without quality loss."
Owen (Field): yes, pilot customer ok to anonymize pending legal. I'll confirm NDA and provide a 2-line blurb by EOD.
bot-scheduler: Provisional webinar slot created: 2024-11-12 14:00 UTC  calendar hold placed. :calendar:
Noor (PMM): subject lines to A/B test:
A) "Cut your LLM inference bill by a third  serving-first tactics"
B) "Keep inference latency predictable as traffic spikes"
C) "Migration playbook: fallbacks, rollouts, and cost controls"
Ravi (Content): recommend A for demand-gen, B for platform lists, C for executive invites.
Maya (Marketing): ops: Ravi to draft one-pager + slides; Sam to post sales lines; Priya methods + table; Owen procurement FAQ + case blurb; Noor landing + webinar. lock assets in 5 business days.
Sam (Sales): adding two objection handlers for pricing variability and vendor lock-in; will attach sample phrasing.
Owen (Field): drafting vendor-exit FAQ: how customers export logs, model traces, and rollbacks. procurement likes explicit escape hatches.
Priya (Research): methods blurb ETA ~90m; tiny table with p95 and cost delta will follow.
Maya (Marketing): great team. I'll assemble into final PDF + landing and post a link here once ready. thanks! :rocket:
